decision_rule.structure_metadata_tier: All cards remain structurally representable, subject to the separate competition-license and privacy gates.
decision_rule.content_review_eligible: A card is eligible for later code/stdout legal review only if its task has prepared source text and its card hash appears in no scan hit.
decision_rule.structure_only_unscanned: Every card from a task without prepared source text is withheld from code/stdout release.
decision_rule.structure_only_matched: If either scanned field has a matched competition-data pattern, withhold both code and stdout for the entire card.
decision_rule.whole_card_conservatism: Do not release the other content field merely because only one field triggered.

outputs.public: aggregate counts and exact fractions by task and reason; no card hashes, identities, source paths, or matched spans
outputs.private: sorted card-id SHA-256 tier map with task, reason codes, triggering field names, and withheld field names; no raw IDs or values

remaining_required_gates: raw matched-span disposition by an authorized reviewer
final LICENSE NOTICE and dataset metadata
